headline: Security breaches hit OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta amid vendor consolidation
body: A coordinated series of cyberattacks targeted three major AI firms, with one Israeli firm linked to incidents at OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta. Healthcare organizations deploying these vendors for clinical AI, EHR integration, and decision support face immediate supply chain risk questions. The $100M incident at Hugging Face signals that foundational AI infrastructure faces persistent threats. For healthcare AI consultants evaluating third-party models and deployment partners, these breaches underscore the critical need for vendor security audits and contractual liability frameworks before integrating external AI into regulated workflows.
